placement_summary: Grixis is a VM-168 live-pilot placement packet for the GRIXIS shard expression. Its strongest source-bound signals are Black-centered survival, Blue calculation, Red immediacy, volatility, and the boundary against simple evil UBR framing.

moral_and_psychological_profile.summary: Vox Mana models Grixis as Black-centered survival under hostile reality: self-advocacy and adaptation first, Blue weakness analysis as leverage, and Red urgency before the opening closes.
moral_and_psychological_profile.notes: Psychological language is Vox Mana interpretation from bounded Grixis evidence. It must not collapse into generic evil, nihilism, cruelty, chaos, ambition, mechanics, characters, or aesthetics.

core_values.label: Survival Before Comfort
core_values.description: The self treats survival, agency, and adaptation as first principles.

core_values.label: Information As Leverage
core_values.description: Calculation, planning, and weakness analysis become tools for survival and advantage.

core_values.label: Action Before The Opening Closes
core_values.description: Immediacy, zeal, and volatility push Grixis from analysis into action.

behavioral_signals.signal: Look for survival, agency, self-advocacy, and adaptation as the primary language.
Look for calculation that finds weakness and turns information into leverage.
Look for urgent action and volatility tied back to Black-centered survival.

discriminator_questions.purpose: Separates Grixis survival leverage from Esper designed perfectibility.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_supports_this_factio: Supports Grixis when information serves survival, self-advocacy, weakness analysis, and action under pressure.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_weakens_this_faction: Weakens Grixis when information primarily becomes ordered improvement, social perfection, or designed control.

discriminator_questions.question: Is the motion urgent because survival requires leverage, or because instinct and appetite should be followed honestly?
discriminator_questions.purpose: Separates Grixis Black-centered survival from Jund Red-centered instinct and appetite.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_supports_this_factio: Supports Grixis when urgency is tied to survival, calculation, weakness analysis, manipulation, and self-advocacy.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_weakens_this_faction: Weakens Grixis when the answer centers Red gut instinct, emotional truth, appetite, or being unrestrained.

discriminator_questions.question: Is the plan private leverage for survival, or only secrecy, appetite, or experiment without survival pressure?
discriminator_questions.purpose: Separates Grixis Black-centered survival leverage from Dimir secrecy, Rakdos appetite, and Izzet experiment false positives.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_supports_this_factio: Supports Grixis when calculation, weakness analysis, self-advocacy, and urgent action all serve survival under pressure.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_weakens_this_faction: Weakens Grixis when the answer centers hidden leverage without Red immediacy, appetite without Blue calculation, or experiment without Black survival pressure.

how_to_recognize_match: Treat Grixis as a match only when the answer combines Black-centered survival, Blue weakness analysis, and Red urgent action.
Use control, manipulation, ambition, and self-interest only when they serve source-backed survival leverage rather than generic villainy.
Keep mechanics, characters, creature types, deck archetypes, Alara aesthetics, Maestros, Bolas, Sedris, vis, and manual-fill topics out of the match basis.
how_to_recognize_mismatch: Do not match Grixis from UBR color identity alone.
Do not match Grixis from generic villainy, nihilism, cruelty, chaos, ambition, self-interest, or power-at-any-cost language alone.
Do not match Grixis from Maestros/New Capenna material, Nicol Bolas characterization, named figures, creature types, mechanics, deck archetypes, or Alara aesthetics.
Do not match Grixis when information lacks Red urgency, urgency lacks Blue analysis, or self-interest lacks Black survival pressure.
do_not_overweight: Do not award Grixis from generic UBR language.
Do not award Grixis from support-only Commander/operator rows.
Do not award Grixis from support-only mechanics, creature types, deck archetypes, or aesthetics.
Do not award Grixis from manual-fill topics, named figures, Bolas, Sedris, or Maestros material.
never_claim_as_canon: Never claim Vox Mana placement planning is official Wizards canon.
Never claim UBR is a live expression key.
Never claim support-only card, Commander, mechanics, character, or aesthetics material proves the Grixis thesis.
Never claim detailed geography, vis, figure, chronology, or exact card-text-derived lore from VM-166.

collision_guidance.separator: Grixis turns information toward survival, agency, weakness analysis, and urgent leverage; Esper turns information toward designed perfectibility and ordered improvement.
collision_guidance.ask: Is the answer trying to optimize the system, or survive it by finding leverage?

collision_guidance.separator: Grixis is Black-centered survival using Blue calculation and Red immediacy; Jund is Red-centered instinct, appetite, and consequence without Blue calculation.
collision_guidance.ask: Does the answer lead with calculated survival leverage, or with gut instinct and appetite?

collision_guidance.separator: Grixis differs from Dimir because hidden leverage must be joined by Red urgency and hostile-reality survival pressure.
collision_guidance.ask: Does the answer act before the opening closes, or stay in secrecy and leverage alone?

collision_guidance.separator: Grixis differs from Izzet because experiment and action must serve Black-centered survival rather than discovery or expression alone.
collision_guidance.ask: Is the experiment about discovery, or about surviving by exploiting a mapped weakness?

collision_guidance.separator: Grixis differs from Rakdos because appetite and pressure must be bounded by Blue weakness analysis.
collision_guidance.ask: Is the pressure calculated survival leverage, or spectacle and appetite without analysis?

collision_guidance.separator: Grixis differs from Blue because study must become survival leverage under Black center and Red urgency.
collision_guidance.ask: Is knowledge being pursued for improvement, or converted into self-preserving action?

collision_guidance.separator: Grixis differs from Black alone because self-advocacy must be sharpened by Blue weakness analysis and Red urgent action.
collision_guidance.ask: Is self-interest alone present, or the full survival-analysis-urgency synthesis?

collision_guidance.separator: Grixis differs from Red alone because urgency must serve Black survival and Blue-mapped leverage.
collision_guidance.ask: Is action expressive impulse, or a survival opening identified by analysis?

collision_guidance.separator: Grixis differs from Sultai because its leverage excludes Green endurance and adds Red urgent volatility.
collision_guidance.ask: Does the answer rest in endurance and accumulation, or strike through urgent survival leverage?

collision_guidance.separator: Grixis differs from Temur because it lacks Green embodied acceptance and centers Black survival pressure.
collision_guidance.ask: Is vitality and instinct leading, or hostile-reality survival leverage?

collision_guidance.separator: Grixis differs from Jeskai because disciplined action and insight do not substitute for Black-centered survival pressure.
collision_guidance.ask: Is action disciplined by a code, or driven by survival leverage?

collision_guidance.ask: Is speed serving a war code, or a mapped survival opening?

collision_guidance.separator: Grixis differs from Bant because public honor and communal order are missing pressures, not Grixis proof.
collision_guidance.ask: Is the answer asking for collective order, or self-advocating survival under pressure?

collision_guidance.separator: Grixis differs from Abzan because endurance and kinship do not replace Blue analysis plus Red urgency.
collision_guidance.ask: Is the pressure ancestral endurance, or urgent survival leverage?

collision_guidance.ask: Is the answer about communal life-scale, or survival through weakness and opening?
